(async function () {
  const checks = [], $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
  const check = (value, label) => { if (!value) throw Error(label); checks.push(label); };
  const until = async (predicate) => { const end = Date.now() + 10000; while (!predicate()) { if (Date.now() > end) throw Error("Timed out: " + predicate); await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 25)); } };
  const requests = () => fetch("/fixture/requests").then((response) => response.json());
  const mode = (value) => fetch("/fixture/mode", { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify(value) });
  const tab = () => document.querySelector('[data-tab="tasks"]');
  const card = (id) => document.querySelector('[data-task-id="' + id + '"]');
  const action = (id, name) => card(id)?.querySelector('[data-task-action="' + name + '"]');
  const returnToTasks = async () => {
    if (!$('view-session').hidden) $('s-crumb-project').click();
    await until(() => !$('view-project').hidden); tab().click();
    await until(() => !$('tab-tasks').hidden && $('tasks-new'));
  };
  await until(() => $('project-nav').querySelector('button') && $('kpis').children.length === 4);
  $('project-nav').querySelector('button').click();
  await until(() => !$('view-project').hidden && tab());
  check(!(await requests()).some((request) => request.path === '/api/tasks'), 'tasks load only when opened');
  tab().click();
  await until(() => !$('tab-tasks').hidden && !$('tasks-refresh').disabled);
  check(tab().classList.contains('active') || tab().getAttribute('aria-selected') === 'true', 'tasks tab selection');
  check($('tasks-list').textContent.length > 0, 'empty task guidance');
  $('tasks-new').click();
  await until(() => $('new-task-dialog').open && !$('task-create-submit').disabled);
  check($('task-type').value === 'feature', 'new task defaults to feature');
  check($('task-permission').value !== 'read-only', 'worker starts with editing permission');
  $('task-type').value = 'release'; $('task-type').dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
  check($('task-version').required && !$('task-version').disabled, 'release requires version');
  $('task-type').value = 'feature'; $('task-type').dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
  $('task-title').value = '로그인 버튼 수정';
  await mode({ holdCreate: true });
  $('new-task-form').requestSubmit($('task-create-submit'));
  await until(() => $('task-create-submit').disabled);
  $('new-task-form').requestSubmit($('task-create-submit'));
  await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 60));
  check((await requests()).filter((request) => request.path === '/api/tasks' && request.method === 'POST').length === 1, 'duplicate create submit is blocked');
  await fetch('/fixture/release', { method: 'POST' });
  await until(() => !$('new-task-dialog').open && !$('view-session').hidden);
  await returnToTasks();
  await until(() => card('task-1'));
  check(card('task-1').textContent.includes('feature/task-1') && card('task-1').textContent.includes('develop'), 'created task shows GitFlow branch and target');
  check(action('task-1', 'open-session'), 'task links its session');
  action('task-1', 'finish').click();
  await until(() => $('finish-task-dialog').open);
  $('task-finish-message').value = 'fix: 로그인 버튼 수정';
  $('task-finish-description').value = '버튼 동작을 고칩니다.';
  $('task-finish-verification').value = '테스트 통과';
  $('finish-task-form').requestSubmit($('task-finish-submit'));
  await until(() => !$('finish-task-dialog').open && card('task-1')?.querySelector('a[href="https://github.com/fixture/repo/pull/42"]'));
  check(card('task-1').textContent.includes('리뷰'), 'finishing opens PR and enters review');
  const finished = (await requests()).find((request) => request.path === '/api/tasks/task-1/finish');
  check(finished?.body.message === 'fix: 로그인 버튼 수정' && finished.body.verification === '테스트 통과', 'finish sends commit and verification details');
  $('tasks-new').click();
  await until(() => $('new-task-dialog').open && !$('task-create-submit').disabled);
  $('task-title').value = '긴급 수정 <img src=x onerror="window.taskInjected=1">'; $('task-type').value = 'hotfix'; $('task-type').dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
  $('new-task-form').requestSubmit($('task-create-submit'));
  await until(() => !$('new-task-dialog').open && !$('view-session').hidden);
  await returnToTasks(); await until(() => card('task-2'));
  check(card('task-2').textContent.includes('hotfix/task-2') && card('task-2').textContent.includes('main'), 'hotfix targets main');
  check(!card('task-2').querySelector('img') && !window.taskInjected && card('task-2').textContent.includes('<img'), 'task titles render as text');
  await mode({ uncertain: true });
  action('task-2', 'finish').click(); await until(() => $('finish-task-dialog').open);
  $('task-finish-message').value = 'fix: 긴급 수정';
  $('finish-task-form').requestSubmit($('task-finish-submit'));
  await until(() => document.body.textContent.includes('중복 실행'));
  check((await requests()).filter((request) => request.path === '/api/tasks/task-2/finish').length === 1, 'uncertain write is never retried automatically');
  if ($('finish-task-dialog').open) $('finish-task-dialog').close();
  action('task-2', 'refresh').click();
  await until(() => card('task-2')?.textContent.includes('리뷰'));
  check(card('task-2').querySelector('a[href="https://github.com/fixture/repo/pull/42"]'), 'refresh reconciles uncertain PR');
  check((await requests()).filter((request) => request.path === '/api/tasks/task-2/finish').length === 1, 'recovery only reads PR state');
  await mode({ contextFailure: true }); $('tasks-refresh').click();
  await until(() => document.body.textContent.includes('원격 확인 실패'));
  check(card('task-1') && card('task-2'), 'remote failure preserves stored tasks');
  await mode({ contextFailure: false }); $('tasks-refresh').click();
  await until(() => !$('tasks-refresh').disabled);
  return checks;
})()
